typography_notes: All text appears on a light-gray ground with no bullets anywhere (pure title slide). Title: large sans-serif (Arial-like) bold, two centered lines, red, roughly 3x the subtitle size. Subtitle: sans-serif bold, dark blue, centered. 'Prepared By' and the name under it are serif (Times New Roman-like) italic / bold-italic, while the email beneath is sans-serif bold — a mixed serif/sans lockup. 'Instructors:' is sans-serif bold italic red; instructor names are sans-serif bold italic blue; emails are smaller regular sans-serif blue. Slide number is a plain numeral inside an oval. No all-caps except the tiny logo tagline 'UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY'.
animation_state: Fully revealed static title slide; nothing mid-build. The only overlay is a mouse cursor from the video capture near the right-middle of the slide.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray #E8E8E8. 2. Draw a rectangle with no fill and a ~2.5pt red (#C00000) outline, inset ~0.15 in from all four edges, to form the frame. 3. Top-right (inside frame): insert a small oval (~0.5 x 0.35 in), fill #FFFF99, outline #6633CC ~1.5pt, and type '1' centered in it (dark gray/black, ~12pt). 4. Add a centered text box spanning ~80% width at ~25% height with two lines: 'Linear Regression &' then 'Classification'; Arial Bold, ~44pt, color #C00000, centered. 5. Below it add a centered text box with 'CSAI 253  -  Spring 2024' (keep the wide spaces around the hyphen); Arial Bold ~24pt, color #2222CC. 6. Add a centered three-line block at ~63-77% height: line 1 'Prepared By' (Times New Roman Italic ~20pt, #C00000); line 2 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' (Times New Roman Bold Italic ~22pt, #2222CC); line 3 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial Bold ~14pt, #2222CC). 7. Bottom-left, left-aligned five-line text box: 'Instructors:' (Arial Bold Italic ~18pt, #C00000); 'Dr. Khaled Mostafa ElSayed' (Arial Bold Italic ~16pt, #2222CC); 'kmelsayed@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial ~14pt, #2222CC); 'Dr. Mohamed Maher Ata' (Arial Bold Italic ~16pt, #2222CC); 'momaher@zewailcity.edu.eg' (Arial ~14pt, #2222CC). 8. Bottom-right: place the Zewail City logo (insert official image if available). To fake it: teal #339999 square with tiny white Arabic 'مدينة زويل للعلوم والتكنولوجيا' at top, a white curved emblem shape in the middle, bold white 'ZEWAIL CITY', and tiny white 'UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY'; immediately to its right a white rectangle with bold maroon #A03030 Arabic 'جامعة العلوم والتكنولوجيا' over smaller dark-red #8B0000 'University of Science and Technology'. 9. Add no bullets, charts, or equations — this is a title-only slide. 10. Do NOT reproduce the mouse cursor; it is a video artifact.
